title: The Demon Within
summary: Attacked by the savage Lesser Imp, Ha-Jun suffers excruciating biological reconstruction as his Demon Sovereign bloodline overrides his human frailty. Driven by ancient instinct, he unleashes the demonic gauntlet to annihilate the beast—awakening Kuro's telepathic consciousness.

panels.action: The 8-foot tall Lesser Imp launches forward in a ferocious sprint, clawed feet ripping chunks out of the rain-slicked concrete floor.
The beast's massive serrated blade-arm sweeps horizontally downward in a lethal arc aimed directly at Ha-Jun's neck.
In hyper-slow motion, Ha-Jun sees the blade coming and throws himself sideways into a desperate evasive dive.
The demon's scythe arm shears cleanly through the thick industrial metal perimeter railing, throwing sparks into the pouring rain.
Ha-Jun skids on his knees through a deep puddle, gasping for air as he stares in horror at the severed steel posts.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Agar wo vaar mujhe lagta... toh meri gardan katt jaati!

panels.action: The Imp whips around with chilling unnatural speed, yellow eyes gleaming with sadistic mockery through the rain.

dialogue.speaker: imp_demon
dialogue.text: KEE-KEEK! EK BHEEGE CHUHE KI TARAH BHAAG RAHE HO?!

panels.action: The demon unhinges its jaw and spits a rapid volley of glowing green-black acidic venom globes toward Ha-Jun.
Ha-Jun instinctively throws his crystalline gauntlet up to shield his face; the venom globes splatter against the obsidian armor and hiss into harmless vapor.
Ha-Jun's body suddenly convulses with unbearable internal heat; the Sovereign's ancient bloodline rejects human weakness.
Ha-Jun clutches his collar, coughing violently as glowing violet mana mist leaks between his trembling fingers.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: K-Khoon mein... ubaal aa raha hai...!!

panels.action: Abstract vision: Ancient Demon Sovereign genetic strands forcibly overwriting human DNA, super-charging muscles and bones with dark mana.

dialogue.text: Insaan ki hadd par... shaitan ka janam ho raha tha.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's head arches back as he unleashes a primal scream; an eruption of neon-violet magical fire engulfs his silhouette.
Extreme macro: Ha-Jun's eyes flare with brilliant violet rings and sharp vertical black slit pupils, radiating chilling divine pressure.

dialogue.text: Sovereign ki aankhein khul chuki theen.

panels.action: The towering Lesser Imp stumbles backward in sheer horror, wings shivering as ancient ancestral hierarchy crushes its spirit.

dialogue.speaker: imp_demon
dialogue.text: Y-Yeh astitva...?! Yeh sirf ek insaan nahi ho sakta...!

panels.action: Ha-Jun slowly straightens his spine; all trembling and pain have vanished, replaced by cold, regal, terrifying calm.
Ha-Jun exhales a plume of pure white mana steam into the freezing rain; his expression is ice-cold and merciless.
Ha-Jun disappears from sight in a sonic flash-step, leaving behind a circular shockwave crater in the wet concrete floor.
Ha-Jun manifests instantaneously 12 feet in the air directly above the Lesser Imp, his right gauntlet cocked back like an anvil.
The Imp frantically crosses both scythe arms upward to block, its yellow eyes wide in desperate panic.
Ha-Jun's crystalline purple gauntlet smashes down through the demon's scythe guard into its skull with blinding violet lightning.
Massive wide shot: The shockwave obliterates thousands of raindrops in a gigantic radial dome; roof tiles shatter into dust.
The Lesser Imp is smashed flat into a massive circular crater in the concrete floor, dark demon blood spraying onto the puddles.
Standing over the demon, Ha-Jun clenches his fist; three radiant violet mana spikes erupt from his knuckles, piercing the demon's heart.
The demon howls one final screech as its monstrous form disintegrates into glowing purple ash and black smoke.
Where the demon's body lay, only a polished diamond-shaped violet demonic core crystal remains, hovering above the rain puddle.
The crystalline gauntlet generates a magnetic suction vortex, absorbing the core crystal into the back of Ha-Jun's hand.
System UI flashes: [TARGET ELIMINATED: LESSER IMP] | [MANA ABSORBED: BLOODLINE SYNCHRONIZATION 2.5%].
The crystalline armor plates click and dissolve back into Ha-Jun's skin, leaving his normal pale hand without a single scratch.
Ha-Jun slumps back against the concrete parapet, gasping for breath as human fatigue crashes back into his frail body.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Maine... maine ek monster ko maar daala...?

panels.action: A swirling wisp of purple ember hovers near Ha-Jun's ear. An ancient, aristocratic, sardonic voice echoes directly in his mind.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: KAMAAL KA KHEL THA, MERE BACHE. AB WAQT HAI SACH JAAN NE KA.
